summary.headline: Edge data-security settings, remediation-agent, and setup-migration guidance is refreshed
summary.overview: The day updates an Edge data-security Settings Catalog step, the Security Copilot Vulnerability Remediation Agent, and Intune setup migration documentation.
summary.adminImpact: Review the current policy-deployment and migration references before modifying security or tenant-transition workflows.

keyChanges.title: Edge data-security Settings Catalog guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft revised the Settings Catalog step five documentation for Edge data security.

keyChanges.title: Vulnerability Remediation Agent guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Security Copilot Vulnerability Remediation Agent documentation was updated.

summary.headline: Microsoft 365 packaging update includes Intune improvements and security features
summary.overview: A Message Center notice describes a mid-June to early-August 2026 Microsoft 365 packaging update with security features, Intune improvements, and increased Exchange Online storage.
summary.adminImpact: Review the announcement and configure applicable policies; assess how the included Intune improvements and new security capabilities affect tenant controls.

keyChanges.title: Microsoft 365 Packaging Update is announced
keyChanges.detail: The announced update rolls out mid-June through early August, adding security capabilities including Defender Plan 1 and URL time-of-click protection, Intune improvements, and 50 GB additional Exchange Online storage; Business SKU backfill is expected by September 30.

keyChanges.title: Setup migration guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune setup migration documentation was revised.

summary.headline: Trustd mobile threat-defense integration is documented
summary.overview: Microsoft adds a Trustd Mobile Threat Defense integration article and updates third-party compliance partners and Microsoft 365 Apps baseline settings.
summary.adminImpact: Mobile security teams evaluating Trustd should use the new documentation to validate integration design and review linked compliance controls.

keyChanges.title: Trustd Mobile Threat Defense integration guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published documentation for Trustd Mobile Threat Defense with Intune.

keyChanges.title: Third-party compliance partners guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune third-party device compliance partners reference was revised.

summary.headline: Intune announces future iOS/iPadOS 18 and macOS 15 support minimums
summary.overview: Microsoft plans to require iOS/iPadOS 18 or later and support macOS 15 or later after Apple’s 2026 platform releases; the announcements include distinct treatment for existing and new enrollments.
summary.adminImpact: Identify affected devices now with Intune reporting and plan OS upgrades. Pay particular attention to new enrollments, userless ADE devices, and enforcement controls before the changes take effect.

keyChanges.title: iOS and iPadOS 18 support minimum is planned
keyChanges.detail: After Apple’s iOS/iPadOS 27 release, Intune plans to require iOS/iPadOS 18 or later; organizations should identify affected devices and note separate requirements for userless ADE devices.

keyChanges.title: macOS 15 support minimum is planned
keyChanges.detail: After macOS Golden Gate 27, Intune plans to support macOS 15 and later; existing devices on macOS 14.x or lower can remain enrolled, but new enrollments on those versions will not be allowed.

summary.headline: Remote Help deployment and session-start guidance is updated
summary.overview: Microsoft updated the Intune Remote Help deployment and session-start documentation.
summary.adminImpact: Remote-support teams should revalidate deployment and help-desk session procedures against the current guides.

keyChanges.title: Remote Help deployment guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The Intune documentation for deploying Remote Help was revised.

keyChanges.title: Remote Help session-start guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft updated the Remote Help documentation for starting a session.
